Hemingray and American Manufactured

This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.

Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites

The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.
